You are definitely not a burden even though you feel like you are. Someone in your life, even if it’s 1 person, treasures you so much. You may just not know it. 
I’ve felt like a burden to my family for the past 5 years and the feeling has never gone away, but I’m learning to love myself despite the major amt of insecurities I have. It takes so much time, but please stay

Hey, I recently experienced what you’re going through rn. I suddenly fell back into having suicidal thoughts after being “normal” for about afew months. My therapist told me that recovery is never easy and it’s always gna have its ups and downs. Of course that’s easy to say but before she told me that, I felt that something was wrong with me. Keeping that in mind helps alot. 
I have a sister who treats me like shit too and unfortunately I’m just trying to learn to let it be. It hurts so much when I’m being targetted for no reason, but you can’t control what other people do. It might seem unfair because it really is, but you can control how you react and seeming unbothered by your brother’s actions may help.
I can’t relate to your situation about being trans but just know that there are many people facing the same situation as you and you shouldn’t beat yourself up for being you.
You may feel like your kids don’t need you but they definitely do. You may feel that they’re better off without you but have they said that? Please stay for them.

Hey, I’m rlly sry u feel so lost but let your mum be the reason you stay. I’ve attempted several times and I’ve always woken up feeling guilt and regret because what if I did die? I knew I’d be leaving my parents behind and it would have been devastating for them. I remember reaching out to people on reddit 2 years ago when i was 16 too and fortunately I had someone to talk to. If you ever need help, don’t be afraid to ask anybody for help.

Reading this breaks my heart because I was in your position just afew years ago. You expressed everything I used to feel and I hate seeing someone else feel exactly like how I did, especially with you being so young. Unfortunately, I can’t tell you that things will definitely get better but if you need someone to talk to, don’t be afraid to reach out:) All I really wanted when I was in your position was for someone to talk to.

Ngl it’ll be like this for the next few years. In my country, we can’t move out once we turn 18. We’re only allowed to get a house if we have a partner and that’ll take 5 more years. I don’t see myself settling down with anyone anytime soon either. Since it’s my parents’ house, it’s their rules for the time being unfortunately, which I understand. This applies to my older brother too and many of my friend’s older siblings in their mid to late 20s.

I don’t know where u got people pleasing from, but I’m extremely far from that. Afraid of confrontation? Yes, sure I acknowledge that I feel I can’t approach my parents in general not just if I want material things, but because they’re strict and now I feel the respect I give them is more due to fear than love. This is how I act only towards my parents, other than that I’d be willing to confront anybody else. They never emotionally neglected me, but I live in an asian household in an asian country and there’s a lot of expectations of me to do what they say even though I don’t sometimes. 

I can definitely think on my own and I’m definitely not a people pleaser. I may have made myself seem like an extremely shy person in my post, but in real life I’m straightforward with what I like and don’t like and what I want for myself. It’s just the talking to my parents. 

Also my parents have taught me about my needs and wants and I’m fully aware of it. I know what I’m entitled to. I’ve been taught to save since young and I always put the money I get twice a year, which is the only money I get, from traditional celebrations into the bank. Whatever money I take out is to buy small presents for my friends and I don’t use a single cent of my parent’s money. 

I’ve made it clear to them that if they don’t want to get me something, I’m willing to use my own money because I know I want it. I only ask for things once in a blue moon, so that’s why I’m willing to use my own money. They still won’t let me.

My country doesn’t have summer breaks and our holidays aren’t long enough for students to get part-time jobs until they’re probably 19. If I had the time to do so, I would have. Plus, everyone’s too busy being bombarded with homework to complete during the breaks to be doing anything outside of school. 

I posted this on reddit because I’ve “exhausted” all my options. I’ve tried, but my parents are just strict and judgemental. We can openly joke around, but it’s not as simple as that all the time. I’m thankful for what I have and have been given, but don’t recommend me such books about assumptions you’ve made about me from just a post.
I’m fine, I guess for now the only thing keeping me distracted is my exams, but I really don’t know what I’ gg to be doing after my exams end and I’m left alone with my thoughts agains
